panels.title: ${project}
panels.description: Only the selected production project. CPU is a share of total host capacity; RAM is combined container working set. Resource presence does not prove application readiness.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(max by(name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="cadvisor",image!="",name!="",container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"${project:regex}"}[5m]))) / scalar(count(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode="idle"})) and on() (min(up{job="cadvisor"}) == 1) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)

panels.title: Project / CPU and RAM
panels.description: Only the selected project's usage. CPU and RAM use total host capacity as the denominator, not container quotas; the axis scales to observed usage.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(max by(name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="cadvisor",image!="",name!="",container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"${project:regex}"}[5m]))) / scalar(count(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode="idle"})) and on() (min(up{job="cadvisor"}) == 1) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)

100 * sum(max by(name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="cadvisor",image!="",name!="",container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"${project:regex}"})) / scalar(sum(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node"})) and on() (min(up{job="cadvisor"}) == 1) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: Container: ${container:raw}. RAM used is working set, excluding inactive file cache. RAM limit is a cap, not reserved memory. No cap means no effective cap below host RAM; missing limits are Unknown. RAM % is N/A without a usable limit.

options.styles: & { overflow-x: hidden; } .dt-row { padding: 0; min-width: 0; } .container-pairs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; padding: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; } .container-card { min-width: 0; padding: 7px; border: 1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.3); border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(127,127,127,.06); } .container-card h3 { margin: 0 0 5px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .container-card dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 3px 6px; margin: 0; } .container-card dt, .container-card dd { margin: 0; min-width: 0; line-height: 18px; letter-spacing: 0; } .container-card dt { font-size: 11px; opacity: .8; } .container-card dd { font-size: 12px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .load-normal { color: #73bf69; } .load-warning { color: #ffb357; } .load-critical { color: #f2495c; } .load-unknown { opacity: .65; } .container-empty { padding: 12px; }
